# The declared names held back, for tests/test_declared_holdbacks.py, which says what holds each reason to the tree.
# One `<name> | <reason>` per line, sorted. A declared name not listed is held by something the tree shows: an import
# here (a shipped page, an example, the courier host, another package), Discodon's import list
# (tests/fixtures/host_imports/discodon.txt, its production and test imports mixed), a shipped page's prose or code,
# or a declared signature.
#
#   discodon-tests-only       Only Discodon's tests import it: no page names it, no declared signature reaches it.
#                             It goes provisional once Discodon re-pins without it.
#   port-host-implements      A declared protocol a host's code implements and hands the engine.
#   protocol-engine-provides  A declared protocol the engine implements and hands a host's code, or that the engine's
#                             own storage satisfies over the host's store.
#   unreached                 Declared, and nothing imports, names or reaches it. None.
#
# Computed 2026-11-06 over this tree at a3f15bfd8 and Discodon develop at e5a7f2a56 (2026-11-03): a Discodon test is
# a file under tests/, a conftest.py or a test_*.py; the rest is its production code, which also reads the four
# seed defaults (gen.EVAL_BOUNDARY_GEN_TEMPLATE_DEFAULT, gen.EVAL_PROPOSER_TEMPLATE_DEFAULT,
# analysis.EVAL_ANALYSIS_GEN_DEFAULT, and analysis.EVAL_REPORT_PLAN_DEFAULT; both analysis constants are removed in
# this release, so that read breaks at re-pin) by name. 24 discodon-tests-only (25 less generate_analysis, removed with the
# shims in R4), 18 port-host-implements, 13 protocol-engine-provides, 0 unreached.
